decision: Resolve the A06 remediation-ownership gap prospectively while preserving A06-0001 as FAIL. Assign constitutional runtime remediation to an A05 correction attempt; canonical schemas to the shared C01 correction; generated projections to C02; compatibility to C03; conformance to C04; packaged snapshot to B04; and the independent audit only to A06-0002. Preserve existing package dependencies. A05 must implement the exact G00-G14 registry and 23-node evolution_promotion workflow within its exact runtime, workflow, documentation, fixture, test, and evidence paths, pass 24 negative/adversarial and six positive cases, and only then may A06 audit the complete chain before any x05 package starts.
